scope: 320 retrieval contexts: original 4000/12000 reused, new 8000/16000. Eight original feature contexts excluded here.

definitions.coverage: Frozen necessary source evidence, 80% line coverage; test aggregate excludes Q19, n=15.
definitions.length: Actual final o200k tokens including every table/metadata/source, test n=16. Source tokens counted separately before table serialization.
definitions.duplicate: Mean per-context fraction of repeated (path,line) occurrences in Sources; measures chunk overlap only, not semantic redundancy.
definitions.unjudged: Mean unique source-line fraction outside frozen necessary-evidence union, test n=15. Includes potentially useful context; NOT noise or irrelevance rate.
definitions.timing: New in-memory cached embedding lookups differ from original disk-cache adapter; cross-run timing is not a method speed comparison.
